note: Vela Maps (app.vela, #120). The 'capture' fixtures come from the route-capture harness (Vela 0.5.2621 on the Android 17 emulator, 2026-10-30: London en-GB and Austin en-US, car; every one of the 102 captured cards matched); the others are synthetic. The FIELD STRUCTURE comes from Vela's public source (NavigationService.buildNotification, values/strings.xml, ui/Format.kt): the title is 'In <distance> · <instruction>' while the next maneuver is ahead, the bare instruction at distance 0, 'Arrived' at the destination and 'Navigating' before the first instruction; the text is '<duration> · <distance> · Arrive <time>', optionally followed by ' · To <stop>' and ' · <n> min faster available'. Distances are '<n> ft' or '%.1f mi' (imperial) and '<n> m' or '%.1f km' (metric); the clock is 12- or 24-hour. The instruction wording is Vela's router's (Valhalla, OSRM or GraphHopper), so these fixtures use wording typical for those engines. The ruleset starts from the rules proposed by the #120 reporter; check it against real captures (route capture, or a diagnostics export).
